evidence: Lossless-extraction evidence only. Not HDS parity.
limitations: Silver shaping and normalization rules (fabric_silver/normalize.py) are re-implemented from reading the HDS v1.4.0 normalization source and are source-derived, UNVERIFIED against a captured HDS run; no captured reference data exists, so this is not verified parity. Columns carrying the pre-normalization value: idOrig, identifierOrig, meta_lastUpdatedOrig, meta.lastUpdatedOrig, birthDateOrig, deceasedDateTimeOrig. Other date/dateTime/instant values are parsed to UTC without an Orig copy. Known divergences: unknown JSON fields (including primitive extensions such as _birthDate) are rejected instead of dropped; msftFilePath is the logical path, not the OneLake URI; Spark from_json/to_json text formatting is emulated, not executed.

silverColumns.name: msftModifiedDatetime
silverColumns.note: shape_row ingest_time (UTC). HDS sets it and msftCreatedDatetime together (dataframe_utils.add_normalized_current_timestamp_column); later-update handling belongs to the writer.

silverColumns.name: id
silverColumns.note: sha256 hex of '<source system without scheme>/<resourceType>/<id>' (identifier_normalization.normalize_resource_id).

silverColumns.name: msftSourceSystem
silverColumns.note: shape_row source_system (the batch's source system).

silverColumns.name: msftFilePath
silverColumns.note: shape_row logical_path. Divergence: HDS records input_file_name(), the OneLake file URI.

silverColumns.name: meta
silverColumns.note: Parsed; meta.lastUpdated date-normalized with meta.lastUpdatedOrig appended.

silverColumns.name: identifier
silverColumns.note: Conformed, deduplicated and given a fhirId element when none exists; each assigner is reference-normalized (identifier_normalization.normalize_resource_identifier).

silverColumns.name: birthDate
silverColumns.note: Parsed as a date, then normalized to midnight UTC (date_normalization.normalize_date).

silverColumns.name: deceasedDateTime
silverColumns.note: Source string parsed to a UTC timestamp; normalize_date leaves timestamps unchanged.

silverColumns.name: contact
silverColumns.note: contact[].organization reference-normalized.

silverColumns.name: generalPractitioner
silverColumns.note: Reference normalization (reference_normalization.normalize_ref_struct): literal/logical references resolved against msftSourceSystem; original moved to msftSourceReference.

silverColumns.name: managingOrganization
silverColumns.note: Reference normalization (reference_normalization.normalize_ref_struct): literal/logical references resolved against msftSourceSystem; original moved to msftSourceReference.

silverColumns.name: link

silverColumns.name: meta_lastUpdated

silverColumns.name: meta_lastUpdatedOrig

silverColumns.name: deceasedDateTimeOrig
silverColumns.note: deceasedDateTime before date normalization (equal for timestamps).
